title: The University of Freiburg Medical Center Extracorporeal Organ Support Device Registry
official: The University of Freiburg Medical Center Extracorporeal Organ Support Device Registry
summary: A prospective registry collecting pseudonymized clinical and treatment data from all patients treated with extracorporeal organ support (i.e., VV ECMO, VA ECMO, ECPR, Impella, IABP, and others) on the wards of the Department of Interdisciplinary Medical Intensive Care at the Freiburg University Medical Center.
conditions: Medical Condition Requiring Extracorporeal Organ Support
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Treatment with any kind of extracorporeal organ support

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
